subject: Snapshot Phasing & Emergency Purge Safeguards
messages:
From: Joanna Patel <joanna.patel@healthsync.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Chris Bell <cbell@medica-consult.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term snapshot retention extension + purge guard

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To summarize our ask from HealthSync: we're running a two-week data migration (legacy -> new tenant) starting 2026-07-20 and need a short-term change to the snapshot retention and purge workflow to avoid accidental data loss during the cutover. Specifically: 

- Can Redwood temporarily extend snapshot retention to 45 days for our tenant (vs. the 30-day default) for the migration window?
- We need a documented emergency purge safeguard: if a purge is ever triggered during the window we want a manual escrow + 72-hour hold before irrevocable deletion, plus an ops contact list.

Attached is our migration-plan.xlsx (high level). We're happy to sign a short DPA addendum for this exception.

Can you confirm feasibility and an ops-level runbook we can review?

Best,
Joanna Patel
Head of Platform Operations | HealthSync
joanna.patel@healthsync.com

---
Attachment: migration-plan.xlsx (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Joanna Patel <joanna.patel@healthsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Chris Bell <cbell@medica-consult.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term snapshot retention extension + purge guard

Joanna — thanks for the clear summary and the deck. We can do this with a short operational addendum. Proposed approach (ops + legal + infra):

1) Snapshot phasing: flag HealthSync tenant snapshots for a 45-day retention window effective 2026-07-19 00:00 UTC through 2026-08-31 23:59 UTC. After that window the tenant reverts to 30 days automatically unless you request an extension.

2) Emergency purge safeguard: implement a two-step manual purge process for that tenant during the window: 
   - Purge requests are routed to a manual approval pipeline (ops on-call + account owner).
   - If approved, snapshots are marked for escrow and a 72-hour irreversible-hold timer begins. During the 72 hours snapshots are readable by engineering for restore; irreversible deletion requires a second signoff.

3) Contacts / SLAs: we'll provide a runbook and a contact escalation list. Our SLA for manual response during this window will be 4 hours for initial ack and 24 hours for first remediation action.

I've attached a one-page snapshot-phasing-proposal.pdf with the flow. If this matches your needs, we'll draft the DPA addendum and route for signature (DocuSign).

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik for the runbook and log-retention alignment.

—Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term snapshot retention extension + purge guard (runbook notes)

Thanks Sean — quick ops notes (inline):

> 1) Snapshot phasing: flag HealthSync tenant snapshots for a 45-day retention window...
- + Agree. Need to ensure our snapshot TTL system supports tenant-level overrides. Ops will create tenant flag and a rollback playbook (we've done similar for Marketplace pilots).

> 2) Emergency purge safeguard: two-step manual purge process...
- Recommend we add an automated 'safeguard lock' that prevents irreversible deletion until both (a) manual approval flows and (b) a second human signoff. Also include a short audit artifact (who clicked approve & when).

> 3) Contacts / SLAs: 4hr ack / 24hr remediation action
- Good, but ops asks for a 1-hour on-call paging path if purge is initiated (pager duty escalation) — we'll include that in the runbook.

I'm attaching purge-runbook-draft.docx (internal draft) with exact steps, pages for escalation, and a checklist for pre- and post-purge verification. Karthik — can you confirm any dataflow/log retention impacts (KV cache logs + async MV logs) so we don't accidentally expire lineage data during the retention bump?

Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment: purge-runbook-draft.docx (internal stub)

From: Joanna Patel <joanna.patel@healthsync.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Bell <cbell@medica-consult.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term snapshot retention extension + purge guard

Sean / team — thank you. This plan looks good and addresses our primary concerns. Two small asks before we sign: 

1) Please add the short automated safeguard lock Marissa mentioned (prevents deletion until dual signoff).
2) Add a clause to the addendum clarifying the escrow restore window (72 hours) and that HealthSync has the ability to request immediate restore within that period.

If you include those two items in the DPA addendum, we'll route for signature. I'm attaching the DocuSign link for the addendum — please route it to Kimberly for redlines and then to our legal team (copy me).

Thanks — Joanna
